alt: 三名學生熱心栽種幼苗，一名同齡學生卻穿得過分正式，昂首背手指點眾人，擺出自負又暮氣沉沉的姿態。
scene_prompt: Meaning: someone, even young, acts pompously seasoned, puts on airs, and lacks youthful vitality. In a contemporary school gardening club, three lively teenagers plant seedlings and invite a fourth to help. The fourth teenager stands apart in an overly formal cardigan, one hand behind his back and the other pointing critically, chin raised and expression smugly world-weary, lecturing instead of joining; his unused trowel lies clean beside him. He is clearly young, contrasting with the others' energetic teamwork.
